title: A countable ε-net of n-planes for the orthogonal-projection norm
statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ with n ≤ N and let ε > 0. Then there is a sequence Q_0, Q_1, Q_2, … of linear subspaces of ℝ^N = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N), each of dimension n, such that every n-dimensional linear subspace P of ℝ^N satisfies ‖q_P − q_{Q_j}‖ < ε for some j ∈ ℕ, where q_V = V.starProjection : ℝ^N →L[ℝ] ℝ^N is the orthogonal projection onto V and ‖·‖ is the operator norm.
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (ε : ℝ), n ≤ N → 0 < ε → ∃ Q : ℕ → Submodule ℝ (Rn N), (∀ j, finrank ℝ (Q j) = n) ∧ ∀ P : Submodule ℝ (Rn N), finrank ℝ P = n → ∃ j, ‖P.starProjection - (Q j).starProjection‖ < ε
